summary.source: S111 live-code survey, game-loop review, release operations review, S110 production receipts and typed premise checks. Completed S109/S110 work is excluded. No real player cohort is claimed.
summary.verificationNote: Every ranked gap is checked against current source. The launch remains HOLD independently of technical deployment. Priority = impact x innovation / log2(effortHours + 2), rounded to one decimal.

gameLoopReview.evidence: Source-design assessment only. No consented player cohort or D1/D7 retention observations exist.

phantomsRejected.reason: The ordinary S110 checkpoint push completed after several minutes and the narrow follow-up push completed in eight seconds. The old task describes latency as a deadlock; reclassify it during closeout, and optimize only against a measured need.
public/lib/firstSeasonContract.js implements five goals and a season verdict; S110 corrected the player-controlled trade objective.
public/game.html and public/styles.css now contain a six-group drawer and shared SVG sprite; S110 visual receipt covers dark/light desktop/mobile.
weeklyPlanComposer, seasonChapters and returnDigest already produce source-bound weekly and return receipts.
Synthetic tests and self-selected local receipts cannot establish player comprehension, return intent, or cohort retention.

recommendedMoves: Build a bounded deterministic CPU-to-CPU market using existing trade legality, with matched seed and transaction-volume controls and visible league news.
Require typed inbound delivery plus reply-as identity before launch evidence can mark project-domain mail verified; preserve HOLD until independent proof exists.
Join roster and depth decisions in one Team workspace, then carry club identity across the league and market surfaces without a boot-cost regression.

secondOrderCandidates.trigger: Adding the CPU market made the public-truth gate reject a stale hand-maintained 43-module claim; the build itself knows the source count and can render it without a human update.
evidence: Pages build rendered the derived 44 in static/index.html

items.title: Make rival clubs transact with each other under cap and roster law, and let the player see a changing league
items.premise: GameSession only scheduled inbound offers targeted at the controlled team. No CPU-to-CPU market existed; the canonical three-season observation recorded zero such trades.
items.executionEvidence: Matched-seed three-year spec 3/3; rival-offer neighbors 10/10; final direct six-shard suite 1,588/1,588 (core 290, runtime 849, sim-contract 85, realism 9, long 3, Studio 352). Exact-source CI, staging 14/14 and live Pages 10/10 succeeded. The first direct run found an omitted visual capture ledger append; it was repaired before the final green receipt.

premises.claim: No CPU-to-CPU trade market module exists
The weekly runtime schedules inbound offers

L1.recipe: Introduce a deterministic CPU-only trade candidate selector with strict cap, roster, and deadline rejection; log accepted transactions in League News.

L2.recipe: Integrate a bounded deterministic CPU–CPU offer-and-accept market at weekly advance through the existing TradeService; preserve picks, cap, roster and transaction invariants, explain both clubs' need and surplus, and render news. Compare matched seeded three-season controls for transaction volume and parity before enabling it.

L3.recipe: Add multi-season market memory, persona-aware bid/ask negotiation, a readable trade ecology report, and player-visible ripple effects on standings, roster needs and rivalry narratives with matched counterfactual evidence.

items.title: Make launch evidence require a checkable receive-and-reply-as receipt
items.premise: launch-evidence-report marked an arbitrary nonempty --email-evidence string verified; the current canon requires receiving on the project domain and replying as that alias.
items.executionEvidence: Structured Zoho inbound and recipient-observed alias reply validator; freeform and forged controls rejected. Focused launch evidence 17/17 and release-truth 26/26. Actual mail receipt absent, so public launch remains HOLD.

premises.claim: A freeform nonempty email evidence string is accepted

L1.recipe: Reject freeform strings and preserve unverified state until a structured receipt is supplied.

L2.recipe: Parse a structured project-domain mail receipt with inbound delivery and reply-as-alias evidence, schema validation, address matching and negative controls; keep current launch HOLD and fixture tests honest.

L3.recipe: Add source IDs, independent header/message witnesses and expiry/freshness validation, then show which of receive, reply identity or DNS failed without exposing personal addresses.

items.title: Put roster and playing-time decisions in one navigable Team workspace
items.premise: The six-group menu had separate Roster and Depth Chart destinations; a lineup change forced navigation away from the players being compared.
items.executionEvidence: One Team destination with Roster/Depth submodes; two hidden depth routes corrected; 34/34 focused Node navigation tests and focused real-browser keyboard/depth flow green. 158 final-source dark/light desktop/mobile pixels reviewed with zero blocking defects and hashes recorded in the capture ledger.

premises.claim: Depth remains a separate primary destination

L1.recipe: Add a contextual route from Roster to Depth with return navigation and preserved selected player.

L2.recipe: Create one Team destination with Roster and Depth submodes; preserve exact tab IDs and deep links, keyboard focus, history and mobile drawer behavior. Verify both themes and phone/desktop pixels while switching modes.

L3.recipe: Add a comparison rail that previews snap-share changes for the selected player before save, with undo and accessibility narration.

items.title: Survive transient shared-host SSH pre-auth resets without weakening host identity
items.premise: The exact-source GitHub deploy workflow failed after build on SCP/SSH pre-auth resets. Its old remote steps had one transport attempt per workflow run.
items.executionEvidence: Pinned host-key secret provisioned from a previously trusted and freshly verified host; bounded transport helper, reset-success and terminal-failure controls 15/15. Backend workflow 36652030133 succeeded through deploy-server; independent HTTPS health reported source 9400912 and database ready.

premises.claim: Workflow uses a single appleboy SCP action

L1.recipe: Wrap transport with a short bounded retry and explicit failure report.

L2.recipe: Replace fragile transport with bounded noninteractive SCP/SSH retry steps that enforce known-host identity; test reset-then-success and terminal failure locally. Keep deployment idempotent and distinguish workflow success from independent recovery.

L3.recipe: Add concurrency-aware backoff, staged artifact checksum and same-host source receipt before proxy reload; emit a machine-readable transport failure class.

items.title: Let club identity follow the GM through league and market decisions
items.premise: Procedural crests appeared in the Desk spotlight and optional share cards, but league and market decision surfaces did not mount them.
items.executionEvidence: Lazy team-specific crest mounts in League and Trades; both passed real-browser assertions after a fresh game boot, and their dark/light desktop/mobile states were reviewed in the final-source visual receipt.

premises.claim: The Desk mounts the team crest
The transaction surface has no crest mount

L1.recipe: Add the controlled club crest beside team identity in one high-value transaction panel.

L2.recipe: Mount lightweight procedural crests in the league and trade decision surfaces using the shared lazy module; retain text labels and avoid new boot dependencies. Review dark/light desktop/mobile pixels and accessibility names.

L3.recipe: Carry crest identity into weekly receipts, rival trade consequences and dynasty chronicle with a consistent compact grammar and share-card parity.

items.title: Let the build publish the engine's real size without a manual stat edit
items.premise: The CPU market exposed a stale hand-maintained public count. A source placeholder now declares derived authority; the Pages renderer substitutes the actual module count before publishing and the truth gate rejects missing or contradictory declarations.

premises.claim: Landing source declares a derived engine count
Pages derives the count from source modules

L1.recipe: Update the landing number when the engine module count changes and let the existing gate catch stale edits.

L2.recipe: Render the landing stat from the source module count at build time; keep a fail-closed source marker and verify the built HTML contains the exact count with no placeholder leak.

L3.recipe: Generalize derived claim markers for other public numbers with source-specific resolvers and a build receipt explaining each figure's authority.

items.executionEvidence: node scripts/check-public-truth.mjs passed at 44 modules; npm run build:pages succeeded; static/index.html rendered data-engine-system-count>44 with no marker.
